stable.headline: Groups that align and copy as one piece, a macOS feel and sharp pixels
notes: Align and Spread work on groups, and copying several groups makes a whole folder for each.
Pivots of copied groups, and of groups moved together, stay where they belong.
Windows, menus and the quick colour wheel have a macOS feel.
Edges and icon lines are sharp to the pixel.
Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D and Ctrl+V copy, duplicate and paste materials.
Undo no longer leaves a ghost copy of a group.
